title: The Brink of Extinction
start: Talk to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the TzHaar City's main plaza.

recommended.t: A TokKul-Zo for increased damage against enemies and teleports around the TzHaar City

kills.t: Must be able to defeat a considerable number of level 100+ foes, including:

rewards.t: 275000 Combat XP lamp in a choice of scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic or scl | Necromancy (skill must be level 80 or higher)
Ability to smith obsidian armour and donate 15,000 Tokkul to a coffer at the Fight Cauldron to temporarily buff the armour
Access to the Fight Cauldron and an added teleport to the TokKul-Zo
Ability to find a wandering Ga'al

steps.t: Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the main plaza of TzHaar City. [Chat: Accept]
Run east through the arch. A cutscene will begin.
Run north-east to the Birthing Pool and speak to TzHaar-Mej-Het. [Chat: 4 I require TokKul. › 1 That's the TokKul I'm looking for!]
Run around the wall to where the Fight Kiln entrance is, and mine the Statue of TzHaar-Ket-Teg.
Run south-west to the TzHaar City entrance. Mine the nearby Statue of TzHaar-Xil-Kal.
Return to the main plaza. Melt the two stacks of fragments into TokKul with the furnace slightly south-east of the main plaza.
Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh again. [Chat: 5 Goodbye.]
Go to the entrance to the Library, north-west of the main plaza and speak to Ga'al. [Chat: Any]
Run south until you reach the cooking icon on the minimap. Speak to the next Ga'al. [Chat: Any]
Continue south along the eastern wall to the southwest corner of the city (east of the TzHaar City mine), and speak to the final Ga'al. [Chat: Any]
Return to the main plaza and speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh again.
Enter the Fight Kiln entrance east of Main Plaza. [Chat: 1 'The Brink of Extinction'.]
A cutscene plays. [Chat: 1 We have to take the risk. Reforge the Ga'al in the Kiln.]
p: A player mining at a statue for some fragments

steps.t: Run to the easternmost part of TzHaar City, where a cave entrance is. The entrance is not clickable until after you interact with the orb, cave entrance is indicated on your map.
Activate the communication orb in your backpack. [Chat: 1 TokKul of TzHaar-Mej-Gek.]
Enter the cave.
Kill the 4 Tz-Kih.
Pick up the mace, sword and knife.
Put the mace on the western and the sword on the eastern scales.
Go through the ancient gate.
Kill the 2 Tz-Kek.
Kill the Tz-Kih and Tok-Xil

Move the statues such that TzHaar-Mej faces TzHaar-Ket, who faces TzHaar-Xil, who faces TzHaar-Mej. This involves a triangle formed by Xil and Mej (parallel) to the south and Ket to the north. If it doesn't work, make the triangle smaller.
Go through the ancient gate.
Turn off Auto-retaliate so your character does not inadvertently step on a glowing square when running to attack a monster (they deal 1000+ damage per second).
Pass the hot vent door to the east.
Avoid standing on glowing floor squares.
Kill the 2 TokHaar-Kets and 2 TokHaar-Hurs.
Kill the 3 TokHaar-Xils.
Kill the TokHaar-Ket Champion and pick up the obsidian maul it drops.
Pass back through the hot vent door.
Place the maul on the scales.
Go through the ancient gate.
Kill the 4 Tz-Kils.
Pick up each of the obsidian weapons: throwing ring, sword, mace and staff.
Place each of the obsidian weapons on the scales according to their location:
Go through the Ancient gate.
Kill the 3 Tz-Kihs.
Kill the 2 Tz-Kils and Yt-MejKot.
Touch one of the pedestals.
Touch the pedestals in the order that they light up until the puzzle is complete. There are 8 combinations you will need to complete correctly.

sub.t: Recommended to give each pedestal a number between 1-4. Write the number of the last pedestal that lights up each round in your chatbox, forming a list. When touching pedestals, simply follow the numbers in your chatbox.

steps.t: Go through the Ancient gate.
Turn off Auto-retaliate so your character does not inadvertently step on a glowing square when running to attack a monster (they deal 1000+ damage per second).
Pass the hot vent door to the east.
Avoid standing on glowing floor squares.
Kill the 4 TokHaar-Hurs.
Kill the 2 TokHaar-Xils.
Kill the 2 TokHaar-Mejs.
Kill the 2 TokHaar-Ket Champions and pick up the obsidian maul dropped.
Pass back through the Hot vent door.
Place the maul on the scales.
Go through the ancient gate.
Kill the 3 Tz-Keks.
Pick up the sword, maul, mace, knife and staff.
Inspect each scale for the TzHaar word. Use the correct obsidian weapon on each scale according to the table below:
Go through the ancient gate.
Kill the 3 Tz-Kils.
Kill the Ket-Zek and 2 Tz-Keks.
Rotate the tiles on the ground to form the TzHaar symbol.
Go through the Ancient gate.
Pass the hot vent door to the east.
Talk to Ga'al-Xox. [Chat: Any]
Rotate the eastern valve.
Kill TokHaar-Hok.

sub.t: You cannot teleport out or leave the fight early.
Pray Deflect/Protection from Melee the entire fight.
Avoid standing on glowing floor squares, as always.
You do not need to kill the spawned enemies - higher level players may focus on TokHaar-Hok. When he is defeated, the spawned enemies will die.
Stun TokHaar-Hok once he has lost half his health, this prevents him from healing at the flowing lava.

The stun mechanic may be bugged and you may only be able to use basic Ranged ability, Binding Shot, the basic Magic ability, Impact and the Magic threshold ability, Asphyxiate, and the basic melee ability, Backhand.
In Legacy Mode, you need to stun him with a special attack.

p: Fighting the first wave of TokHaar in the TzKot-Zo

steps.t: Talk to TokHaar-Hok.
Talk to Ga'al-Xox. [Chat: Any]
Talk to Ga'al-Xox again. [Chat: 5 Farewell.]
Return to the city through the door. Activate your communication orb.

sub.t: If you have destroyed your communication orb, talk to either TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the main plaza of TzHaar City.

steps.t: Go back to the Fight Kiln entrance. [Chat: 1 'The Brink of Extinction']
A cutscene ensues. [Chat: 1 I can't wait to battle the TokHaar. › Any]
Quest complete!

p: Ancient scales activated with an Obsidian mace
Fighting a Tok-Xil in the second room
Activating the conduit has summoned TokHaar-Hok |

get_inside.text: TokKul-Zo teleport directly to the Fight Cave, Fight Kiln, Fight Cauldron, Fight Pit, or city centre.
Fairy ring BLP is located near the Fight Cave.
Amulet of glory teleport to Karamja, then run west from the banana plantation to the main entrance atop the Karamja Volcano.
Karamja lodestone teleport, then run east from Brimhaven, through the members' gate, to the volcano.
